concerns.text: FR-008 and US-1 explicitly require a 'Generalization Set' (N_test >= 500) with structurally distinct problems. Tasks T013, T016, and T044 are marked as unchecked (missing implementation) or rejected in the analyze report. No active task exists to generate this specific dataset, leaving the core validation requirement unimplemented.

The spec's Edge Cases require detecting and filtering 'logical contradictions (unsolvable problems)' during generation. Task T014 (contradiction detection/SAT check) is unchecked. No alternative task covers this specific requirement, risking the generation of invalid training data.

FR-007 mandates Bonferroni correction for ALL p-values (including ANOVA). Tasks T031 (pairwise t-test) and T032 (Bonferroni correction) are unchecked. T030 implements ANOVA but lacks the correction logic, leaving the statistical output unverifiable against the spec.

FR-004 and SC-002 require evaluating student models on the held-out test set. Task T029 (evaluation script) is unchecked and flagged in the analyze report as missing the `data/raw/test_set.csv` artifact (due to T013 failure). Without a valid test set generation task, the evaluation task cannot function.

FR-009 requires validating that teacher traces exhibit entropy consistent with problem entropy. Task T022-INT attempts this but defines a filter based on `abs(trace_entropy - problem_entropy_score) > threshold`. Since trace entropy (Shannon) and problem entropy (structural metadata) are in different units, this logic is mathematically impossible to implement as written, failing to satisfy the requirement.

FR-006 mandates that the final report MUST explicitly frame findings as 'causal regarding the effect of entropy on performance' based on the controlled experimental design. Task T034 conditionally inserts this phrase ONLY if p < 0.05. This violates the absolute requirement to frame the findings causally regardless of the statistical significance outcome.
